name: CS-H083 12–46T cassette
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 576 g for the CS-H083 8-speed 12–46T ED Black cassette, with 12/15/18/21/24/30/37/46T sprockets; lockring inclusion is assumed under the catalogue guidelines. The 505 g figures for 12–42T and 11–42T are different configurations.
